meta.name: systematic-debugging
meta.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 系统化排查并修复代码缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位和修复代码中的问题。
copy.tagline_en: Systematically diagnose and fix code defects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix issues in code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在遇到任何 bug、测试失败或意外行为时，会先系统性地调查根本原因，然后才提出修复方案。它遵循四个阶段：根本原因调查、模式分析、假设与测试、实施。
howto.when: 当你报告任何技术问题（如测试失败、生产环境 bug、性能问题）时触发。特别适用于时间紧迫、看似简单或已尝试多次修复的情况。

say.text: 这个测试一直失败，帮我找出根本原因。
say.note: Claude 会启动 Phase 1 调查。

say.text: 我试了两次修复都没用，接下来怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会检查是否已达 3 次限制，并考虑架构问题。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will systematically investigate root causes before proposing fixes for any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior. It follows four phases: Root Cause Investigation, Pattern Analysis, Hypothesis and Testing, and Implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you report any technical issue such as test failures, production bugs, or performance problems. Especially useful under time pressure, for seemingly simple issues, or after multiple failed fix attempts.

say_en.text: This test keeps failing. Help me find the root cause.
I tried two fixes and they didn't work. What now?
say_en.note: Claude will check if 3-fix limit is reached and consider architecture.
